title: FluidR3 GM — Woodblock (MIDI program 116), note 56
processing: MP3 note sample decoded to mono, resampled to 22.05 kHz, first 0.36 s kept, 0.6 ms fade-in and 30 ms fade-out, peak normalised, stored as 16-bit PCM in base64. At run time the moktak sound adds a resonator tuned to the recording's own lowest mode (hollow body ring) and softens the stick click; the mogeo (wooden fish) sound is the same recording resampled to 0.46x speed with the same kind of resonator. No other recordings are mixed in.
note: A recording of a real wooden percussion instrument, not of the moktak at Bulguksa.
